const crypto = require('crypto');

/**
 * Generates a deterministic cache key from the request path and query parameters.
 * 
 * Normalization rules:
 * - null or undefined query params are treated as absent.
 * - Empty string "" is preserved.
 * - Parameters are sorted alphabetically by key to ensure consistency regardless of order.
 * 
 * @param {string} path - The request path (e.g., '/api/users')
 * @param {Object} queryParams - The parsed query parameters object
 * @returns {string} A SHA-256 hash of the normalized path and parameters
 */
function generateCacheKey(path, queryParams) {
    // Filter out null/undefined values
    const normalizedParams = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(queryParams)) {
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined) {
            normalizedParams[key] = value;
        }
    }

    // Sort keys alphabetically to ensure consistent ordering
    const sortedKeys = Object.keys(normalizedParams).sort();
    
    // Build a canonical string representation
    const canonicalString = sortedKeys.map(key => `${key}=${normalizedParams[key]}`).join('&');
    const fullString = `${path}?${canonicalString}`;

    // Hash the canonical string
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fullString).digest('hex');
}

module.exports = { generateCacheKey };
```
